meta_description: thunder — a private metasearch engine. no logs, no trackers, no profiles.
hero_body: search the web {mark} — no logs, no trackers, no profiles.
hero_note: results aggregated from many engines, anonymously. your queries never become a profile.
privacy_one_line: no logs · no trackers · no ads · no income — a community search engine.
footer_note: no tracking cookies · no search history on our servers
nonprofit_line: nonprofit · no ads · no tracking · no income — forever.
developer_credit: built by zerouki ahmed mouad · زروقي أحمد معاذ
results_none_body: try different words, another category, or check your spelling.
proxy_note: you are reading anonymously through thunder's proxy. scripts, ads and trackers were stripped from the page.
settings_newtab: open results in a new tab
about_body: thunder is a metasearch engine: instead of running its own index, it asks many independent engines on your behalf, anonymously, and stitches the answers together. your searches pass through thunder without leaving a trail — no cookies for tracking, no search history stored, no ip addresses logged.
feature_multi_body: independent engines are queried in parallel; duplicates are merged and results ranked by agreement.
feature_images_body: free-to-use images with licenses shown on every result.
feature_news_body: fresh headlines with dates and sources, localized to your language.
feature_proxy_body: any result can be opened through thunder's proxy: scripts and trackers stripped, you read like a ghost.
feature_instant_body: type a math expression and get the answer without leaving the box.
feature_i18n_body: full interface in arabic (with right-to-left layout), english and french.
privacy_points: we do not log your ip address, ever.
we do not store your searches — they exist only while your request is being answered.
we set no tracking or advertising cookies, and we send none to third parties.
the anonymous reader strips scripts, ads and trackers from every page you proxy.
recent searches, if enabled, live only in your browser's local storage — clearable in one click.
err_body: the engines did not answer. try again in a moment.
shortcut_hint: press / to focus the search box
settings_engines_note: choose which engines thunder queries — at least one per category. saved on this device only.
add_intro: add thunder to your browser's search bar and search privately from the address box, everywhere.
add_step_detect: easiest way — open the home page once: most browsers detect thunder automatically via the search icon in the address bar.
add_manual_title: or add it manually with this address template:
add_chrome_body: settings → search engine → manage search engines → add: name "thunder", url as shown above, then set as default.
add_brave_body: settings → search engine → manage search engines → add: name "thunder", url as shown above, then set as default.
add_firefox_body: open the home page once → a green plus icon appears in the address bar → click it and check "add thunder". then choose it in settings → search.
add_edge_body: settings → privacy, search and services → address bar and search → manage search engines → add, then set as default.
add_mobile_note: on phones: chrome for android supports custom engines in settings; ios users can add thunder as a safari bookmark with the shortcut key.
